newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo commission approves 160 mln mark bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Yugo commission approves 160 mln mark bond issue.

text.p: The Yugoslav Securities Commission on Wednesday approved the first issue of short-term hard currency bonds worth 160 million marks for the Serbian transport ministry, state news agency Tanjug reported.

Funds raised from the sale of the issue, sold within the country, will be used for the construction of sections of trans-Yugoslav highways and development of the network of trunk and regional roads in Serbia, the report said.
IBP Beograd - Coca-Cola shareholding company of Zemun received approval for second issue of shares worth 60 million dinars ($10.34 million).

The commission also approved the first issue of long-term hard currency bonds worth $50 million maturing in mid-2000 for Beogradska banka. Funds raised from their sale will be used to support Yugoslav economy's export programmes, the report said. -- Amra Kevic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 311 4305
